title: Building an Emergency Fortress
subtitle: Protect your finances against unexpected shocks with a dedicated safety buffer.

steps.content: Life happens: tires go flat, roofs leak, or unexpected medical bills pop up. An emergency fund is your financial shield!
steps.tip: Having cash reserves stops an emergency from turning into high-interest credit card debt.

steps.title: How Much Emergency Savings Do You Need?
steps.content:
Starter Buffer: $1,000 as fast as possible to prevent relying on credit cards for minor surprises.

Full Fortress: 3 to 6 months of essential living expenses (rent, groceries, and vital bills).

Where to store it: A High-Yield Savings Account (HYSA) where it earns competitive interest with zero risk and instant liquidity.
steps.highlight: Emergency funds belong in a safe, liquid High-Yield Savings Account.

steps.question: What is the recommended size for a fully funded emergency fortress?
steps.hint: Financial advisors recommend holding enough cash to cover 3 to 6 months of essential living expenses.

options.text: 3 to 6 months of essential living expenses
options.explanation: 3 to 6 months covers living costs in case of unexpected income loss or major medical emergencies.
One week of pocket money is far too small for genuine emergencies.
Holding 10 years of cash is excessive and loses buying power to inflation.

steps.title: What Counts as a Real Emergency?
steps.content:
An expense qualifies for emergency fund usage if it is:
1. Unexpected (you could not plan for it in your monthly budget)
2. Necessary (health, safety, shelter, or ability to commute to work)
3. Urgent (must be handled immediately)
steps.highlight: Emergency criteria: Unexpected, Necessary, and Urgent.

steps.question: Which of the following situations is a valid reason to withdraw from your emergency fund?
steps.hint: Ask if the expense is unexpected, vital for survival or retaining your job, and urgently needed.

options.text: An urgent unexpected car transmission repair needed to commute to work
options.explanation: This is unexpected, urgent, and necessary for your employment.

options.text: A flash sale on a brand-new television
options.explanation: Discounts on electronics are wants, not emergencies.

options.text: A last-minute spontaneous weekend beach trip
options.explanation: Leisure travel belongs in your 30% wants budget.

steps.title: Financial Fortress Established
steps.content: You now have the knowledge to budget, invest, compound wealth, and defend your financial freedom against any unexpected storm.
